title: OASIS EDXL-SitRep 1.0 Situation Report (BEACON core subset)
description: JSON representation of the OASIS Emergency Data Exchange Language Situation Reporting (EDXL-SitRep) 1.0 core (urn:oasis:names:tc:emergency:EDXL:SITREP:1.0). BEACON emits situation summaries as EDXL-SitRep (ADR-010). This is a boundary serialization mapped from the canonical SITREP entity by the EdxlPort anti-corruption adapter (ADR-001). Every SITREP field is grounded by canonical CITATION records (Art. XI/XII); citations are carried in the BEACON API envelope (see source-ref.schema.json), not invented by the LLM (Art. XII).

sitRepIdentifier.description: EDXL-SitRep <SitRepIdentifier> — globally unique identifier (URN) for this situation report.

sitRepType.description: EDXL-SitRep <SitRepType> — the type/purpose of the situation report.

sitRepNumber.description: EDXL-SitRep <SitRepNumber> — sequence number of this report for the incident.

sitRepVersion.description: EDXL-SitRep <SitRepVersion> — version of this numbered report (for amendments).

sentDateTime.description: EDXL-SitRep <SitRepSentDateTime> — origination date/time, ISO 8601 with timezone.

language.description: RFC 3066/BCP-47 language tag for the human-readable text in THIS report instance (summary.*, situationInformation.*, managementReportingDetail.*). NOT a native EDXL-SitRep 1.0 (CS02) element — the core data dictionary defines no Language/LanguageCode/xml:lang construct (verified against the OASIS CS02 spec text, section 1.5 References onward; RFC3066 is cited only as a normative reference, never wired to an element). This field borrows the name and RFC 3066 semantics of OASIS EDXL-DE 2.0's <language>/<contentLanguage> element (0..1, xsd:language) — the EDXL family's actual, standards-defined mechanism for tagging payload/content language — applied at the message level because BEACON emits bare SitRep JSON without an EDXL-DE transport wrapper (ADR-010 scopes RM+SitRep+CAP, not DE). Machine-readable fields (sitRepIdentifier, sitRepType, sitRepNumber, incidentInformation.incidentID/incidentType, summary.trend) are NEVER a function of this field (FUW-2 doctrine, mirrored from CAP <language>, cap-v1.2.schema.json). Multilingual SitRep is therefore per-DOCUMENT (build once per resolved language via alertLocalesFor), unlike CAP's per-<info>-block multilingual mechanism, because SitRep/RM have no repeated-block structure to carry it in.

reportingDateTimeRange.description: EDXL-SitRep <ReportingTimePeriod> — the operational period the report covers.

originatorRoleType.description: EDXL-SitRep <OriginatorRoleType> — role of the reporting entity (e.g. IC, EOC).

incidentInformation.description: EDXL-SitRep <IncidentInformation> — identity of the incident this SitRep concerns.

incidentID.description: Incident id (GLIDE id per ADR-010; maps to canonical INCIDENT.id).

incidentType.description: Hazard type (maps to canonical INCIDENT.type WILDFIRE|FLOOD).

summary.description: EDXL-SitRep <Summary> — high-level narrative summary of the situation. Maps from canonical SITREP.summary; the narrative is LLM-produced but every field is citation-grounded (Art. XII).

headline.description: Short headline of the current situation.

summaryAuthorship.description: Art. VI authorship marker for `executiveSummary` (finding F-410). `AI_GENERATED` = the prose was written by a model (aiMode cloud|local); `DETERMINISTIC` = no model ran and the text is engine-composed. Present whenever `executiveSummary` is. This marks WHO WROTE THE PROSE only — every figure in this document is deterministic and citation-grounded regardless (Art. XII). Previously the AI authorship of this field was stated only in this schema's human-readable description, which no receiving system parses.

trend.description: Escalation trend (maps to canonical SITREP.trend; deterministically derived, Art. XII).

situationInformation.description: EDXL-SitRep <SituationInformation> — structured situational facts (life/safety, infrastructure, resources, priorities).

exposureSummary.description: Deterministically-computed exposure (e.g. N facilities in hazard buffer). Numbers come from the deterministic engine, never the LLM (Art. XII).

priorities.description: Ranked attention areas (maps from canonical SITREP.priorities; deterministically ranked, Art. XII).

actionsTaken.description: Significant actions taken in the reporting period.

geoJsonGeometry.description: GeoJSON geometry object (RFC 7946) per ADR-010 — subset.
